semantic_constraints.revisions: Hugging Face Hub repositories are keyed by repository id and revision sha with lastModified; a pinned sha is immutable and a new sha is a new revision; OpenML dataset versions are their own ids and status, description or checksum changes are new revisions; Epoch rows are vintaged by content digest and a revised estimate is a new revision of its row; gated, disabled, deactivated, 404 and renamed states are source-stated revisions and history is kept
semantic_constraints.cards: card front matter (allow-listed keys) is stored with its digest; the card body is cited by revision URL and digest and never stored
semantic_constraints.observations: self-reported card results (model-index), OpenML run evaluations and Epoch estimates are kept with who reported them and never merged; evaluations are immutable per run id and a run no longer listed becomes not-returned
semantic_constraints.licences: declared licences are stored as stated and normalised to SPDX only on an exact licence-id match through oss_spdx; no licence-compliance interpretation
semantic_constraints.as_of: as-of answers select each source's revision current at the date side by side and cite the Hub sha, the OpenML id and version, or the Epoch vintage, with the as-of time
semantic_constraints.identity: an Epoch entry and a Hub model repository, or a Hub dataset repository and an OpenML dataset, are linked only by a reviewed, revertible identity decision on stated identifiers (repository id, OpenML id, arXiv id, DOI); a shared name is never a match; nothing is auto-merged and unmatched records stay visible
semantic_constraints.links: links to papers (paper connector and scholarly sources), dataset DOIs (DataCite) and registry packages exist only where a source states the identifier or an accepted match carries it; library_name stays stated text; links pin record revisions and degrade to provider_absent or target_not_held
semantic_constraints.minimisation: organisation namespaces only (a user namespace is refused); Hub user and commit authors, OpenML creators, contributors and uploaders and Epoch Authors are refused at parse time; card bodies, commit history, discussions and download, like and trending counts are never stored
semantic_constraints.exclusions: no model weights or dataset files downloaded, no capability, safety, quality, risk or openness verdict, no leaderboard or ranking, no download, like or trending counts, no licence-compliance interpretation, no merging of self-reported card results with OpenML evaluations or Epoch estimates, no inference of training data, compute or parameters where the source states none
